title.en: Volume 269 Biographies 56: Suo Etu, Ming Zhu
title.raw: 卷269 列傳五十六 索额图 明珠

sentences.zh: 索額圖明珠-{余國柱}-佛倫

translations.literal: Songgotu, Mingzhu, Yu Guozhu, Fu Lun
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu, Mingzhu, Yu Guozhu, and Fu Lun

sentences.zh: 索額圖，赫舍里氏，滿洲正黃旗人，索尼第二子。

translations.literal: Songgotu, of the Heseri clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, the second son of Sonin.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu of the Heseri clan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and the second son of Sonin.

sentences.zh: 初授侍衛，自三等洊升一等。

translations.literal: He was first appointed a guard and was promoted in succession from third to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed an imperial guard and rose in succession from third to first rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年，授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year seven he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，自請解任效力左右，復為一等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, he voluntarily requested to resign his post and serve at the emperor's side, and was again made a first-rank guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year eight he asked to resign his office and serve at the emperor's side, and was again made a first-rank guard.

sentences.zh: 及鼇拜獲罪，大學士班布爾善坐黨誅，授索額圖國史院大學士，兼佐領。

translations.literal: When Oboi was convicted, Grand Secretary Ban Buerhan was executed as a partisan; Songgotu was appointed Grand Secretary of the Historiography Institute and concurrently a company commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Oboi was convicted, Grand Secretary Ban Buerhan was executed as his partisan, and Songgotu was appointed grand secretary of the Historiography Institute while also serving as company commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，改保和殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was transferred to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In year nine he was transferred to grand secretary of the Hall of Preserving Harmony.

sentences.zh: 十一年，世祖實錄成，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when the Veritable Record of Emperor Shizu was completed, he was given the additional title of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven, when the Veritable Record of the Shizu Emperor was completed, he received the additional title of grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大學士熊賜履票本有誤，改寫草簽，既又毀去。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Grand Secretary Xiong Cilv's draft memorial contained an error; he rewrote it on a casual slip, then destroyed it.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifteen Grand Secretary Xiong Cilv's draft memorial contained an error; he rewrote it on a scratch note and then destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 索額圖與大學士巴泰、杜立德等疏劾，賜履坐罷歸。

translations.literal: Songgotu, together with Grand Secretaries Batai, Du Lide, and others, submitted a memorial accusing him; Cilv was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu joined Grand Secretaries Batai and Du Lide and others in memorializing against him, and Xiong Cilv was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 十八年，京察，侍講學士顧八代隨徵稱職，翰林院以「政勤才長」注考，索額圖改注「浮躁」，竟坐降調。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, at the metropolitan personnel review, Lecturer Gu Badai was judged by the campaign staff to have performed his duties competently; the Hanlin Academy entered in the review 'diligent in administration and abundant in talent,' but Songgotu changed the entry to 'flighty,' and Gu was in the end demoted on that basis.
translations.idiomatic: At the metropolitan review in year eighteen, Lecturer Gu Badai was rated by the campaign staff as having performed competently, and the Hanlin Academy entered 'diligent in office and gifted in talent' in his review; Songgotu changed the entry to 'flighty,' and Gu was ultimately demoted on that account.

sentences.zh: 語詳顧八代傳。

translations.literal: The matter is related in detail in Gu Badai's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is told in full in Gu Badai's biography.

sentences.zh: 索額圖權勢日盛。

translations.literal: Songgotu's power daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu's power grew day by day.

sentences.zh: 會地震，左都御史魏象樞入對，陳索額圖怙權貪縱狀，請嚴譴。

translations.literal: When an earthquake occurred, Censor-in-Chief of the Left Wei Xiangsu entered audience and presented a memorial on Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and indulgence, requesting severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When an earthquake struck, Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangsu came before the throne and laid out Songgotu's abuse of power, greed, and license, asking for stern punishment.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「修省當自朕始！

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Reform must begin with me!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Reform must begin with me!

sentences.zh: 」翌日，召索額圖及諸大臣諭曰：「茲遘地震，朕反躬修省。

translations.literal: ' The next day he summoned Songgotu and the other ministers and instructed them: 'Now that an earthquake has occurred, I am examining myself in self-reflection.
translations.idiomatic: " The next day he summoned Songgotu and the other ministers and said, "Now that an earthquake has struck, I am examining myself.

sentences.zh: 爾等亦宜洗滌肺腸，公忠自矢。

translations.literal: You too should cleanse your hearts and loyally devote yourselves to the public good.
translations.idiomatic: You too must cleanse your hearts and pledge yourselves to the public good with single-minded loyalty.

sentences.zh: 自任用後，諸臣家計頗皆饒裕，乃朋比徇私，益加貪黷。

translations.literal: Since your appointments, the household circumstances of you ministers have all become quite ample, yet you form factions for private ends and become ever more greedy in office.
translations.idiomatic: Since you took office your households have all grown quite prosperous, yet you band together for private ends and grow ever greedier in your posts.

sentences.zh: 若事情發覺，國法具在，決不爾貸！

translations.literal: If your conduct is discovered, the laws of the state stand ready—I will assuredly not spare you!
translations.idiomatic: If your deeds are exposed, the laws of the state are in force, and I will not spare you!

sentences.zh: 」是時索額圖、明珠同柄朝政，互植私黨，貪侈傾朝右，故諭及之。

translations.literal: ' At this time Songgotu and Mingzhu jointly held the reins of government, each building private factions; their extravagance and greed dominated the court—hence the admonition.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Songgotu and Mingzhu together held the reins of government, each cultivating private factions; their greed and extravagance dominated the court, which is why he spoke of it.

sentences.zh: 上並書「節制謹度」榜賜焉。

translations.literal: The emperor also wrote and bestowed upon them a placard bearing the characters 'restrain desires and be prudent in conduct.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also wrote the words "restrain desires and be prudent in conduct" on a placard and bestowed it on them.

sentences.zh: 十九年八月，以病乞解任，上優旨獎其「勤敏練達，用兵以來，贊畫機宜」，改命為內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the nineteenth year, on grounds of illness he requested to resign; the emperor with a gracious edict praised his 'diligence, acuteness, and mastery' and 'since the opening of military campaigns, his planning of strategy at the council,' and appointed him instead an Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year nineteen he asked to resign on grounds of illness; the emperor with a gracious edict praised his diligence, acuteness, and mastery, and his planning of strategy since the campaigns began, and appointed him an inner minister instead.

sentences.zh: 尋授議政大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was made a Deliberative Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 先是索額圖兄噶布拉，以冊諡孝誠仁皇后推恩所生，封一等公；

translations.literal: Earlier, Songgotu's elder brother Gabula, through the grace granted at the posthumous investiture of Empress Xiaochengren, had been enfeoffed as a duke of the first rank;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Songgotu's elder brother Gabula, through the grace extended when Empress Xiaochengren was given her posthumous title, had been enfeoffed duke of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 弟心裕，襲索尼初封一等伯；

translations.literal: his younger brother Xinyu had inherited Sonin's original enfeoffment as a baron of the first rank;
translations.idiomatic: his younger brother Xinyu had inherited Sonin's original barony of the first rank;

sentences.zh: 法保，襲索尼加封一等公。

translations.literal: Fabao had inherited Sonin's augmented enfeoffment as a duke of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: and Fabao had inherited Sonin's augmented ducal rank of the first class.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月，以心裕等嬾惰驕縱，責索額圖弗能教，奪內大臣、議政大臣、太子太傅，但任佐領，並奪法保一等公。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-third year, because Xinyu and the others were lazy, indulgent, and arrogant, the emperor blamed Songgotu for failing to instruct them, stripped him of his posts as Inner Minister, Deliberative Minister, and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, leaving him only as company commander, and also stripped Fabao of his ducal rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year twenty-three, because Xinyu and the others were lazy, arrogant, and indulgent, the emperor blamed Songgotu for failing to teach them, stripped him of his posts as inner minister, deliberative minister, and grand tutor of the heir apparent, leaving him only as company commander, and also stripped Fabao of his ducal title.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed Senior Guard of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-five he was appointed senior guard of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 時俄羅斯屢侵黑龍江邊境，據雅克薩，其眾去復來，上發兵圍之。

translations.literal: At that time Russia repeatedly invaded the Heilongjiang frontier and held Albazin; when its troops withdrew they returned again, and the emperor sent troops to besiege them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Russia repeatedly raided the Heilongjiang frontier and held Albazin; its forces would withdraw and then return, and the emperor sent troops to besiege them.

sentences.zh: 察罕汗謝罪，使費耀多囉等來議界。

translations.literal: The Tsar Khan apologized and sent Feodosii and others to negotiate the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Tsar apologized and sent Feodosii and others to negotiate the boundary.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，上命索額圖與都統佟國綱往議。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the emperor ordered Songgotu and Commander-in-Chief Tong Guowang to go to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-eight the emperor ordered Songgotu and Commander-in-Chief Tong Guowang to go negotiate.

sentences.zh: 索額圖奏謂：「尼布楚、雅克薩兩地當歸我。

translations.literal: Songgotu memorialized saying: 'Nerchinsk and Albazin should both be returned to us.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu memorialized, "Nerchinsk and Albazin should both be returned to us.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「尼布楚歸我，則俄羅斯貿易無所棲止，可以額爾固納河為界。

translations.literal: ' The emperor said: 'If Nerchinsk is returned to us, Russia will have no place to lodge its trade; the Argun River may serve as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "If Nerchinsk is returned to us, Russia will have nowhere to lodge its trade; the Argun River may serve as the boundary.

sentences.zh: 」索額圖等與議，費耀多囉果執尼布楚、雅克薩為請。

translations.literal: ' Songgotu and the others negotiated; Feodosii indeed insisted on Nerchinsk and Albazin.
translations.idiomatic: " Songgotu and his party negotiated, and Feodosii indeed insisted on Nerchinsk and Albazin.

sentences.zh: 索額圖等力斥之，仍宣上意，以額爾固納河及格爾必齊河為界，立碑而還。

translations.literal: Songgotu and the others forcefully rejected this, still proclaimed the emperor's intent, set the boundary at the Argun and Gorbi Rivers, erected a stele, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu and the others firmly rejected this, proclaimed the emperor's intent, fixed the boundary at the Argun and Gorbi rivers, erected a boundary stele, and returned.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，上以裕親王福全為大將軍，擊噶爾丹，命索額圖將盛京、吉林、科爾沁兵會於巴林，敗噶爾丹於烏闌布通。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the emperor appointed the Prince of Yu Fuquan commander-in-chief to strike Galdan, and ordered Songgotu to bring troops from Shengjing, Jilin, and the Khorchin to assemble at Bailing and defeat Galdan at Ulan Butung.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-nine the emperor appointed Prince Yu Fuquan commander-in-chief to attack Galdan and ordered Songgotu to lead troops from Shengjing, Jilin, and the Khorchin to rendezvous at Bailing, where Galdan was defeated at Ulan Butung.

sentences.zh: 以不窮追，鐫四級。

translations.literal: For failing to pursue to the end, four grades were struck from his rank.
translations.idiomatic: For failing to pursue the enemy to the end, four ranks were struck from his grade.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，從上親征，率八旗前鋒、察哈爾四旗及漢軍綠旗兵前行，並命督火器營。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he accompanied the emperor on the personal campaign, led the Vanguard of the Eight Banners, the four Chahar banners, and the Green Standard Han troops in the advance, and was also ordered to supervise the Firearms Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-five he accompanied the emperor on the personal campaign, led the Eight Banners vanguard, the four Chahar banners, and the Han Green Standard troops in the advance, and was also ordered to supervise the firearms brigade.

sentences.zh: 大將軍費揚古自西路抵圖拉。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Fiyanggu arrived at Tula from the western route.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Fiyanggu reached Tula by the western route.

sentences.zh: 上駐克魯倫河，噶爾丹遁走。

translations.literal: The emperor encamped on the Kerulen River; Galdan fled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor encamped on the Kerulen River while Galdan fled.

sentences.zh: 費揚古截擊之於昭莫多，大敗其眾。

translations.literal: Fiyanggu intercepted him at Jao Modo and greatly defeated his forces.
translations.idiomatic: Fiyanggu intercepted him at Jao Modo and routed his army.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，上還幸寧夏，命索額圖督水驛，會噶爾丹死。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, when the emperor returned and passed through Ningxia, he ordered Songgotu to supervise the water courier stations; soon Galdan died.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-six, as the emperor returned by way of Ningxia, he ordered Songgotu to supervise the water courier stations; soon afterward Galdan died.

sentences.zh: 敘功，复前所鐫級。

translations.literal: When merit was tallied, the previously struck ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: When merit was reckoned, the ranks previously struck from him were restored.

sentences.zh: 四十年九月，以老乞休，心裕代為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fortieth year, on account of old age he requested retirement; Xinyu succeeded him as Senior Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year forty he asked to retire on account of age, and Xinyu succeeded him as senior guard of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 索額圖事皇太子謹，皇太子漸失上意。

translations.literal: Songgotu served the Crown Prince with care, but the Crown Prince gradually lost the emperor's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu served the crown prince attentively, yet the crown prince gradually lost the emperor's favor.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，上閱河至德州，皇太子有疾，召索額圖自京師至德州侍疾。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, when the emperor was inspecting the Grand Canal and reached Dezhou, the Crown Prince fell ill; Songgotu was summoned from the capital to Dezhou to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-one, while the emperor was inspecting the Grand Canal and reached Dezhou, the crown prince fell ill, and Songgotu was summoned from the capital to Dezhou to nurse him.

sentences.zh: 居月馀，皇太子疾愈，還京師。

translations.literal: After slightly more than a month the Crown Prince recovered and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After slightly more than a month the crown prince recovered and returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，心裕以虐斃家人奪官。

translations.literal: That year Xinyu was stripped of office for cruelly beating a household member to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xinyu was stripped of office for cruelly beating a household member to death.

sentences.zh: 四十二年五月，上命執索額圖，交宗人府拘禁，諭曰：「爾為大學士，以貪惡革退，後復起用，罔知愧悔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the forty-second year the emperor ordered Songgotu arrested and imprisoned in the Imperial Clan Court, instructing: 'You were a grand secretary, dismissed for corruption and wickedness, then employed again, yet you know no shame or remorse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year forty-two the emperor ordered Songgotu arrested and imprisoned in the Imperial Clan Court, saying, "You were a grand secretary, dismissed for greed and wickedness, then employed again, yet you know no shame or remorse.

sentences.zh: 爾家人訐爾，留內三年，朕意欲寬爾。

translations.literal: Your household members accused you; you were kept in the inner palace for three years, and I intended to treat you leniently.
translations.idiomatic: Your household members accused you; you were kept within the palace for three years, and I meant to treat you leniently.

sentences.zh: 爾乃怙過不悛，結黨妄行，議論國事。

translations.literal: Yet you cling to your errors and will not reform, form a faction and act recklessly, and discuss state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you cling to your faults and will not reform, form a faction and act recklessly, and discuss affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 皇太子在德州，爾乘馬至中門始下，即此爾已應死。

translations.literal: When the Crown Prince was at Dezhou, you rode your horse to the middle gate before dismounting—on this count alone you deserved death.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince was at Dezhou, you rode your horse to the middle gate before dismounting; on that count alone you deserved death.

sentences.zh: 爾所行事，任舉一端，無不當誅。

translations.literal: Of the things you have done, take any one instance—none would not merit execution.
translations.idiomatic: Of all you have done, take any single instance—none would fail to merit execution.

sentences.zh: ​​朕念爾原系大臣，心有不忍，姑貸爾死。

translations.literal: Considering that you were formerly a high minister, my heart could not bear it; I spare your life for the present.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering that you were once a high minister, my heart cannot bear it, and for the present I spare your life.

sentences.zh: 」又命執索額圖諸子交心裕、法保拘禁，諭：「若別生事端，心裕、法保當族誅！

translations.literal: ' He also ordered Songgotu's sons arrested and placed in Xinyu and Fabao's custody, instructing: 'If any further incident arises, Xinyu and Fabao shall suffer clan extermination!
translations.idiomatic: " He also ordered Songgotu's sons arrested and placed in the custody of Xinyu and Fabao, saying, "If any further trouble arises, Xinyu and Fabao shall suffer clan extermination!

sentences.zh: 」諸臣黨附索額圖者，麻爾圖、額庫禮、溫代、邵甘、佟寶並命嚴錮，阿米達以老貸之。

translations.literal: ' The officials who had attached themselves to Songgotu's faction—Ma'ertu, Ekuli, Wendai, Shao Gan, Tong Bao—were all ordered strictly confined; Amida was spared on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: " The officials who had joined Songgotu's faction—Ma'ertu, Ekuli, Wendai, Shao Gan, and Tong Bao—were all ordered strictly confined; Amida was spared because of his age.

sentences.zh: 又命諸臣同祖子孫在部院者，皆奪官。

translations.literal: He also ordered that all collateral descendants serving in the ministries and courts should be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered that all collateral descendants of these men serving in the ministries and courts should be stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 江潢以家有索額圖私書，下刑部論死。

translations.literal: Jiang Huang, because he possessed private letters from Songgotu at home, was sent to the Ministry of Punishments and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Huang, because he kept private letters from Songgotu at home, was sent to the Ministry of Punishments and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 仍諭滿洲人與偶有來往者，漢官與交結者，皆貸不問。

translations.literal: The emperor again announced that Manchus who had had occasional contact with him, and Han officials who had associated with him, would all be pardoned and not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: He further announced that Manchus who had had only occasional contact with him, and Han officials who had associated with him, would all be pardoned and not questioned.

sentences.zh: 尋索額圖死於幽所。

translations.literal: Before long Songgotu died in confinement.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Songgotu died in confinement.

sentences.zh: 後數年，皇太子以狂疾廢，上宣諭罪狀，謂：「索額圖助允礽潛謀大事，朕知其情，將索額圖處死。

translations.literal: Several years later the Crown Prince was deposed for violent madness; the emperor proclaimed his crimes, saying: 'Songgotu helped Yinreng secretly plot great affairs; I knew the circumstances and had Songgotu put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later the crown prince was deposed for violent madness; the emperor proclaimed his crimes, saying, "Songgotu helped Yinreng secretly plot great affairs; I knew the circumstances and had Songgotu put to death.

sentences.zh: 今允礽欲為索額圖報仇，令朕戒慎不寧。

translations.literal: Now Yinreng wishes to avenge Songgotu and will not let me live in vigilance and peace.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yinreng wishes to avenge Songgotu and keeps me from living in vigilance and peace.

sentences.zh: 」並按誅索額圖二子格爾芬、阿爾吉善。

translations.literal: ' He also had Songgotu's two sons Ge'erfen and A'erjishan executed according to the case.
translations.idiomatic: " He also had Songgotu's two sons Ge'erfen and A'erjishan executed according to the case.

sentences.zh: 他日，上謂廷臣曰：「昔索額圖懷私，倡議皇太子服禦俱用黃色，一切儀制幾與朕相似。

translations.literal: On another day the emperor said to the court ministers: 'In former times Songgotu, acting from private interest, proposed that the Crown Prince's mourning attire and daily utensils all use yellow, and all ritual arrangements nearly resembled mine.
translations.idiomatic: On another day the emperor told the court ministers, "In former times Songgotu, acting from private interest, proposed that the crown prince's mourning dress and daily utensils all use yellow, and that all ritual arrangements nearly resemble my own.

sentences.zh: 驕縱之漸，實由於此。

translations.literal: The gradual growth of pride and indulgence in truth stemmed from this.
translations.idiomatic: The gradual growth of pride and indulgence in truth stemmed from this.

sentences.zh: 索額圖誠本朝第一罪人也！

translations.literal: Songgotu was truly this dynasty's foremost criminal!
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu was truly this dynasty's foremost criminal!

sentences.zh: 明珠，字端範，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人，葉赫貝勒金台石孫。

translations.literal: Mingzhu, styled Duanfan, of the Nara clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner, was the grandson of the Yehe beile Jintaishi.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu, styled Duanfan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and the grandson of the Yehe beile Jintaishi.

sentences.zh: 父尼雅哈，當太祖滅葉赫，來降，授佐領。

translations.literal: His father Niyaha, when Taizu destroyed Yehe, came over in surrender and was appointed company commander.
translations.idiomatic: His father Niyaha, when Taizu destroyed Yehe, surrendered and was appointed company commander.

sentences.zh: 明珠自侍衛授鑾儀衛治儀正，遷內務府郎中。

translations.literal: Mingzhu was transferred from guard to Director of Ceremonial Regulations in the Imperial Insignia Guard, then promoted to director in the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu was transferred from guard to director of ceremonial regulations in the Imperial Insignia Guard, then promoted to director in the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，擢總管。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he was promoted to superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year three he was promoted to superintendent.

sentences.zh: 五年，授弘文院學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Academician of the Hongwen Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In year five he was appointed academician of the Hongwen Academy.

sentences.zh: 七年，命閱淮、揚河工，議復興化白駒場舊閘，鑿黃河北岸引河。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to inspect the Huai and Yangtze river works, and proposed restoring the old sluice at Xinghua's Baijuchang and cutting a diversion canal on the north bank of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven he was ordered to inspect the Huai and Yangtze river works and proposed restoring the old sluice at Xinghua's Baijuchang and cutting a diversion canal on the north bank of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 旋授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 改都察院左都御史，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Left in the Censorate and served as lecturer at the Classic Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to left censor-in-chief in the Censorate and served as lecturer at the classic lecture.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven he was promoted to minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十二年，上幸南苑，閱八旗甲兵於晾鷹台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when the emperor visited the Southern Park and reviewed the armored troops of the Eight Banners on the Hawk-Drying Terrace,
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve, when the emperor visited the Southern Park and reviewed the armored troops of the Eight Banners on the Hawk-Drying Terrace,

sentences.zh: 明珠先布條教使練習之，及期，軍容整肅，上嘉其能，因著為令。

translations.literal: Mingzhu had first laid down regulations for them to practice; when the day came, the military array was orderly and stern, and the emperor praised his competence and made it a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu had first laid down regulations for them to drill; when the day came the troops were in tight order, the emperor praised his ability, and made the practice a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，南疆大定，留重兵鎮之：吳三桂雲南，尚可喜廣東，耿精忠福建。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Kangxi reign, after the great pacification of the southern frontier, heavy troops were left to garrison it: Wu Sangui in Yunnan, Shang Kexi in Guangdong, and Geng Jingzhong in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kangxi reign, after the southern frontier was largely pacified, heavy garrisons were left in place: Wu Sangui in Yunnan, Shang Kexi in Guangdong, and Geng Jingzhong in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十馀年，漸跋扈，三桂尤驕縱。

translations.literal: After more than ten years they gradually grew overbearing; Sangui was especially arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten years they gradually grew overbearing, and Sangui was especially arrogant.

sentences.zh: 可喜亦憂之，疏請撤籓，歸老海城。

translations.literal: Kexi too was troubled and memorialized requesting withdrawal of the princedom and retirement to Haicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Kexi too was troubled and memorialized asking to surrender his princedom and retire to Haicheng.

sentences.zh: 精忠、三桂繼請。

translations.literal: Jingzhong and Sangui followed with similar requests.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong and Sangui followed with similar requests.

sentences.zh: 上召諸大臣詢方略，戶部尚書米思翰、刑部尚書莫洛等主撤，明珠和之。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned the ministers to inquire about strategy; Minister of Revenue Misihan, Minister of Punishments Moluo, and others favored withdrawal, and Mingzhu agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned the ministers to ask their counsel; Minister of Revenue Misihan, Minister of Punishments Moluo, and others favored withdrawal, and Mingzhu agreed.

sentences.zh: 諸大臣皆默然。

translations.literal: All the other ministers were silent.
translations.idiomatic: All the other ministers remained silent.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「三桂等蓄謀久，不早除之，將養癰成患。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Sangui and the others have long nurtured their plot; if we do not remove them early, we will nurse an abscess until it becomes a grave affliction.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Sangui and the others have long nurtured their plot; if we do not remove them early, we will nurse an abscess until it becomes a grave affliction.

sentences.zh: 今日撤亦反，不撤亦反，不若先發。

translations.literal: If we withdraw them now they will rebel; if we do not withdraw them they will also rebel—we might as well strike first.
translations.idiomatic: If we withdraw them now they will rebel; if we do not withdraw them they will rebel too—we might as well strike first.

sentences.zh: 」因下詔許之。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon an edict granting permission was issued.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon an edict granting permission was issued.

sentences.zh: 三桂遂反，精忠及可喜子之信皆叛應之。

translations.literal: Sangui thereupon rebelled, and Jingzhong and Kexi's son Zhixin all rose in revolt in support.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui thereupon rebelled, and Jingzhong and Kexi's son Zhixin all rose in revolt in support.

sentences.zh: 時爭咎建議者，索額圖請誅之。

translations.literal: At the time many blamed those who had proposed the policy; Songgotu requested that they be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many blamed those who had proposed the policy; Songgotu asked that they be put to death.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「此出自朕意，他人何罪？

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'This sprang from my own intent—what crime have others?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "This sprang from my own intent—what crime have the others?

sentences.zh: 」明珠由是稱上旨。

translations.literal: ' From this Mingzhu was said to have gauged the emperor's mind.
translations.idiomatic: " From this Mingzhu was said to have gauged the emperor's mind.

sentences.zh: 十四年，調吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In year fourteen he was transferred to minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授武英殿大學士，屢充實錄、方略、一統志、明史諸書總裁，累加太子太師。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, repeatedly served as chief compiler of the Veritable Records, military chronicles, the Unified Gazetteer, and the History of Ming, and was repeatedly given the additional title of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixteen he was appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, repeatedly served as chief compiler of the Veritable Records, military chronicles, the Unified Gazetteer, and the History of Ming, and was repeatedly given the additional title of grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 迨三叛既平，上諭廷臣以前議撤籓，惟明珠等能稱旨，且曰：「當時有請誅建議者，朕若從之，皆含冤泉壤矣！

translations.literal: When the three rebellions were finally suppressed, the emperor instructed the court ministers that in the earlier discussion on withdrawing the princedoms only Mingzhu and others had grasped his intent, and said: 'At the time some asked that those who had proposed it be put to death—had I followed them, all would now lie wronged in the yellow springs!
translations.idiomatic: When the three rebellions were finally suppressed, the emperor told the court ministers that in the earlier debate on withdrawing the princedoms only Mingzhu and others had grasped his intent, and said, "At the time some asked that those who had proposed it be put to death—had I followed them, all would now lie wronged beneath the earth!

sentences.zh: 明珠既擅政，簠簋不飭，貨賄山積。

translations.literal: Now that Mingzhu monopolized government, his conduct was not restrained; bribes piled up like mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Once Mingzhu monopolized government, his conduct was unrestrained and bribes piled up like mountains.

sentences.zh: 佛倫、餘國柱其黨也，援引致高位。

translations.literal: Fu Lun and Yu Guozhu were his partisans; through his patronage they rose to high position.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lun and Yu Guozhu were his partisans; through his patronage they rose to high office.

sentences.zh: 靳輔督南河，主築堤束水，下游不濬自通。

translations.literal: Jin Fu supervised the southern waterways and advocated building dikes to confine the water so the lower reaches would clear without dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Fu supervised the southern waterways and advocated building dikes to confine the current so the lower reaches would clear without dredging.

sentences.zh: 於成龍等議濬下游，與異議。

translations.literal: Yu Chenglong and others advocated dredging the lower reaches, differing from him in opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong and others advocated dredging the lower reaches, differing from him.

sentences.zh: 輔興屯田，議者謂不便於民，多不右輔，明珠獨是其議。

translations.literal: Fu promoted field colonies; critics said it was inconvenient for the people, and many did not support him—only Mingzhu alone approved his plan.
translations.idiomatic: Fu promoted field colonies; critics said it was hard on the people, and many did not support him—only Mingzhu approved his plan.

sentences.zh: 蔡毓榮、張汧皆明珠所薦引者也，迨得罪按治，恐累舉者，傅輕比，上諭斥，始定。

translations.literal: Cai Yurong and Zhang Han were both men Mingzhu had recommended and introduced; when they were later convicted and punished, for fear of implicating their recommenders the punishments were made light, but the emperor rebuked this and only then were the sentences fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yurong and Zhang Han were both men Mingzhu had recommended; when they were later convicted and punished, the court at first imposed light sentences for fear of implicating their patrons, but the emperor rebuked this and only then were the penalties fixed.

sentences.zh: 與索額圖互植黨相傾軋。

translations.literal: He and Songgotu each built factions and undermined one another.
translations.idiomatic: He and Songgotu each built factions and undermined one another.

sentences.zh: 索額圖生而貴盛，性倨肆，有不附己者顯斥之，於朝士獨親李光地。

translations.literal: Songgotu was born to wealth and eminence and was by nature arrogant and unrestrained; those who would not attach themselves to him he openly cast out, and among court officials he favored Li Guangdi alone.
translations.idiomatic: Born to wealth and eminence, Songgotu was arrogant by nature; he openly cast out those who would not follow him, and among court officials he favored Li Guangdi alone.

sentences.zh: 明珠則務謙和，輕財好施，以招來新進，異己者以陰謀陷之，與徐乾學等相結。

translations.literal: Mingzhu, by contrast, cultivated humility and ease, was free with money and fond of giving, to win over new men; those who differed from him he entrapped by secret plots, and he allied himself with Xu Qianxue and others.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu, by contrast, cultivated humility, was free with money and generous, and won over rising officials; those who opposed him he ruined by secret plots, and he allied himself with Xu Qianxue and others.

sentences.zh: 索額圖善事皇太子，而明珠反之，朝士有侍皇太子者，皆陰斥去。

translations.literal: Songgotu cultivated the Crown Prince's favor, while Mingzhu did the opposite; court officials who attended the Crown Prince were all secretly driven away.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu cultivated the crown prince's favor, while Mingzhu did the opposite; court officials who attended the crown prince were all secretly driven away.

sentences.zh: 薦湯斌傅皇太子，即以傾斌。

translations.literal: He recommended Tang Bin to tutor the Crown Prince, then used this to bring Bin down.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended Tang Bin to tutor the crown prince, then used that very appointment to bring Bin down.

sentences.zh: 會天久不雨，光地所薦講官德格勒明易，上命筮，得夬，因陳小人居鼎鉉，天屯其膏，語斥明珠。

translations.literal: When heaven long withheld rain, Degeli, the lecturer on the Changes whom Guangdi had recommended, was ordered to divine and obtained Guai; he thereupon declared that petty men occupied the tripod cauldron and heaven hoarded its bounty—words that rebuked Mingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: When drought lingered, Degeli, the lecturer on the Changes whom Li Guangdi had recommended, was ordered to divine and obtained Guai; he declared that petty men held the highest offices and heaven hoarded its bounty—words aimed at Mingzhu.

sentences.zh: 事具德格勒傳。

translations.literal: The matter is related in full in Degeli's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is told in full in Degeli's biography.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，御史郭琇疏劾：「明珠、國柱背公營私，閣中票擬皆出明珠指麾，輕重任意。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Censor Guo Xiu memorialized accusing: 'Mingzhu and Guozhu betrayed the public for private gain; all draft endorsements in the Grand Secretariat issued from Mingzhu's direction, light or heavy as he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-seven Censor Guo Xiu memorialized accusing Mingzhu and Guozhu of betraying the public for private gain: "All draft endorsements in the Grand Secretariat issued from Mingzhu's direction, light or heavy as he pleased.

sentences.zh: 國柱承其風旨，即有舛錯，同官莫敢駁正。

translations.literal: Guozhu followed his intent; even when there were errors, his colleagues dared not correct them.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhu followed his lead; even when there were errors, his colleagues dared not correct them.

sentences.zh: 聖明時有詰責，漫無省改。

translations.literal: Though the sage emperor at times rebuked them, they showed no reflection or reform.
translations.idiomatic: Though the emperor at times rebuked them, they showed no reflection or reform.

sentences.zh: 凡奉諭旨或稱善，明珠則曰'由我力荐'；

translations.literal: Whenever an imperial rescript was received or someone was praised, Mingzhu would say, 'Through my strong recommendation';
translations.idiomatic: Whenever an imperial rescript was received or someone was praised, Mingzhu would say, "That was through my strong recommendation";

sentences.zh: 或稱不善，明珠則曰'上意不喜，我從容挽救'；

translations.literal: or when someone was criticized, Mingzhu would say, 'The emperor disliked it; I calmly rescued the matter';
translations.idiomatic: or when someone was criticized, Mingzhu would say, "The emperor disliked it; I calmly rescued the matter";

sentences.zh: 且任意附益，市恩立威，因而要結群心，挾取貨賄。

translations.literal: and he arbitrarily added embellishments, traded favors to build prestige, and thereby bound men's hearts and extorted bribes.
translations.idiomatic: and he arbitrarily embellished matters, traded favors to build prestige, bound men's hearts, and extorted bribes.

sentences.zh: 日奏事畢，出中左門，滿、漢部院諸臣拱立以待，密語移時，上意罔不宣露。

translations.literal: Each day when audience was finished he went out through the Central Left Gate; Manchu and Han officials of the ministries and courts stood bowed awaiting him, and after whispered talk for some time, nothing of the emperor's intent failed to be disclosed.
translations.idiomatic: Each day when audience ended he left through the Central Left Gate; Manchu and Han officials of the ministries and courts stood bowed awaiting him, and after long whispered talk nothing of the emperor's intent failed to leak out.

sentences.zh: 部院事稍有關係者，必請命而行。

translations.literal: On any matter of the ministries or courts that bore the slightest relation to him, they had to ask his leave before acting.
translations.idiomatic: On any ministry or court matter that bore the slightest relation to him, they had to ask his leave before acting.

sentences.zh: 明珠廣結黨羽，滿洲則佛倫、格斯特及其族侄富拉塔、錫珠等，凡會議會推，力為把持；

translations.literal: Mingzhu widely built a faction: among Manchus, Fu Lun, Gest, and his clansmen's nephews Fulata, Xizhu, and others—for every conference and joint recommendation he strove to control the outcome;
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu built a wide faction: among Manchus, Fu Lun, Gest, and his clansmen's nephews Fulata and Xizhu—for every conference and joint recommendation he strove to control the outcome;

sentences.zh: 漢人則國柱為之囊橐，督撫籓臬員缺，國柱等展轉徵賄，必滿欲而後止。

translations.literal: among Han officials Guozhu served as his purse; for posts of governor-general, governor, and provincial commissioner, Guozhu and others passed around demands for bribes and would not stop until their desires were fully satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: among Han officials Guozhu served as his purse; for governor-general, governor, and provincial commissioner posts, Guozhu and others passed around demands for bribes and would not stop until they were fully satisfied.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年學道報滿應升者，率往論價，缺皆預定。

translations.literal: In Kangxi year twenty-three, when provincial education commissioners finished their terms and were due for promotion, they generally went to bargain over price, and all posts were prearranged.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year twenty-three, when provincial education commissioners finished their terms and were due for promotion, they generally went to bargain over price, and all posts were prearranged.

sentences.zh: 靳輔與明珠交結，初議開下河，以為當任輔，欣然欲行。

translations.literal: Jin Fu was allied with Mingzhu; when the lower river works were first proposed, he thought the task should fall to Fu and was eager to undertake it.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Fu was allied with Mingzhu; when the lower river works were first proposed, he thought the task should fall to him and was eager to undertake it.

sentences.zh: 及上欲別任，則以於成龍方沐上眷，舉以應命，而成龍官止按察使，題奏權仍屬輔，此時未有阻撓意也。

translations.literal: When the emperor wished to appoint someone else, he nominated Yu Chenglong, who was then enjoying imperial favor, to answer the command; yet Chenglong's rank was only surveillance commissioner, and the power of memorializing still belonged to Fu—at this time there was still no intent to obstruct.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor wished to appoint someone else, he nominated Yu Chenglong, who then enjoyed imperial favor, to answer the command; yet Chenglong's rank was only surveillance commissioner, and memorial authority still belonged to Fu—at that point he had not yet meant to obstruct.

sentences.zh: 及輔張大其事，與成龍議不合，乃始一力阻撓。

translations.literal: When Fu magnified the affair and his views clashed with Chenglong's, only then did he set himself to obstruct with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu magnified the affair and clashed with Chenglong, only then did he set himself to obstruct with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 明珠自知罪戾，對人柔顏甘語，百計款曲，而陰行鷙害，意毒謀險。

translations.literal: Mingzhu knew his own guilt; toward others he wore a gentle face and sweet words, using a hundred devices to placate them, yet secretly he acted with fierce harm—his intent poisonous and his schemes treacherous.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu knew his own guilt; toward others he wore a gentle face and sweet words and used every device to placate them, yet secretly he acted with fierce harm—his intent poisonous and his schemes treacherous.

sentences.zh: 最忌者言官，惟恐發其奸狀，考選科道，輒與訂約，章奏必使先聞。

translations.literal: He most feared censorial officials, lest they expose his wicked conduct; when censors and investigating censors were selected, he invariably made agreements with them that memorials must be heard by him first.
translations.idiomatic: He most feared censorial officials, lest they expose his crimes; when censors were selected, he invariably made them agree that memorials must reach him first.

sentences.zh: 當佛倫為左都御史，見御史李興謙屢疏稱旨，吳震方頗有彈劾，即令借事排陷。

translations.literal: When Fu Lun was Left Censor-in-Chief, seeing that Censor Li Xingqian's repeated memorials pleased the throne while Wu Zhenfang often impeached others, he ordered that they be brought down on pretext.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu Lun was left censor-in-chief, seeing that Censor Li Xingqian's memorials pleased the throne while Wu Zhenfang often impeached others, he ordered them brought down on pretext.

sentences.zh: 明珠智術足以彌縫罪惡，又有國柱奸謀附和，負恩亂政。

translations.literal: Mingzhu's craft was sufficient to cover his crimes, and with Guozhu's wicked schemes echoing his own, he betrayed grace and threw government into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu's craft was sufficient to cover his crimes, and with Guozhu's wicked schemes echoing his own, he betrayed imperial favor and threw government into disorder.

sentences.zh: 伏冀立加嚴譴。

translations.literal: I humbly pray that stern punishment be imposed at once.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly pray that stern punishment be imposed at once.

sentences.zh: 疏入，上諭吏部曰：「國家建官分職，必矢志精白，大法小廉。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor instructed the Board of Personnel: 'In establishing offices and dividing duties, the state requires men to devote themselves to purity, uphold the great law, and keep themselves clean in small matters.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered, the emperor instructed the Board of Personnel, "In establishing offices and dividing duties, the state requires men to devote themselves to purity, uphold the great law, and keep themselves clean in small matters.

sentences.zh: 今在廷諸臣，自大學士以下，惟知互相結引，徇私傾陷。

translations.literal: Now the ministers at court, from the grand secretaries downward, know only how to draw one another into factions and pursue private ends to undermine rivals.
translations.idiomatic: Now the ministers at court, from the grand secretaries downward, know only how to draw one another into factions and pursue private ends to undermine rivals.

sentences.zh: 凡遇會議，一二倡率於前，眾附和於後，一意詭隨。

translations.literal: Whenever they meet in conference, one or two lead the way at the front and the multitude echo behind, all bent on perverse compliance.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever they meet in conference, one or two lead at the front and the multitude echo behind, all bent on perverse compliance.

sentences.zh: 廷議如此，國是何憑？

translations.literal: When court deliberation is thus, upon what can the state rely?
translations.idiomatic: When court deliberation is thus, upon what can the state rely?

sentences.zh: 至於緊要員缺，特令會同推舉，原期得人，亦欲令被舉者警心滌慮，恐致累及舉者，而貪黷匪類，往往敗露。

translations.literal: As for important posts, the court specially orders joint recommendation, originally hoping to obtain the right men and also wishing those recommended to guard their hearts and cleanse their thoughts, fearing lest they bring down their recommenders—yet greedy and corrupt villains are often exposed.
translations.idiomatic: As for important posts, the court specially orders joint recommendation, originally hoping to obtain the right men and also wishing those recommended to guard their hearts and cleanse their thoughts, fearing lest they bring down their recommenders—yet greedy and corrupt villains are often exposed.

sentences.zh: 此皆植黨納賄所致。

translations.literal: All this stems from building factions and accepting bribes.
translations.idiomatic: All this stems from building factions and accepting bribes.

sentences.zh: 朕不忍加罪大臣，且用兵時有曾著勞績者，免其發覺。

translations.literal: I cannot bear to punish high ministers, and since some rendered merit in wartime, I spare them exposure.
translations.idiomatic: I cannot bear to punish high ministers, and since some rendered merit in wartime, I spare them exposure.

sentences.zh: 罷明珠大學士，交領侍衛內大臣酌用。

translations.literal: Dismiss Mingzhu from the grand secretaryship and refer him to the Senior Guard of the Imperial Bodyguard for appropriate employment.
translations.idiomatic: Dismiss Mingzhu from the grand secretaryship and refer him to the senior guard of the imperial bodyguard for appropriate employment.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，授內大臣。

translations.literal: ' Before long he was appointed Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long he was appointed inner minister.

sentences.zh: 後從上徵噶爾丹，督西路軍餉，敘功復原級。

translations.literal: Later he followed the emperor in the campaign against Galdan, supervised military provisions on the western route, and when merit was tallied his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed the emperor in the campaign against Galdan, supervised military provisions on the western route, and when merit was tallied his original rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 明珠自罷政後，雖權勢未替，然為內大臣者二十年，竟不復柄用。

translations.literal: From the time Mingzhu left office, though his power did not wholly fade, he served as Inner Minister for twenty years and was never again entrusted with the reins of government.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Mingzhu left office, though his influence did not wholly fade, he served as inner minister for twenty years and was never again entrusted with the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-seven he died.

sentences.zh: 子性德、揆敘自有傳。

translations.literal: His sons Xingde and Kuixu have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Xingde and Kuixu have their own biographies.

sentences.zh: -{余}-國柱，字兩石，湖廣大冶人。

translations.literal: Yu Guozhu, styled Liangshi, was a native of Daye in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Guozhu, styled Liangshi, was a native of Daye in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 順治九年進士，授兗州推官。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the ninth year of Shunzhi, he was appointed investigating censor of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Shunzhi year nine, he was appointed investigating censor of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷行人司行人，轉戶部主事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to clerk in the Courier Service, then promoted to director in the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to clerk in the Courier Service, then promoted to director in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 康熙十五年，考授戶科給事中。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi he passed examination and was appointed supervising censor of the Revenue Section.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year fifteen he passed examination and was appointed supervising censor of the Revenue Section.

sentences.zh: 時方用兵，國柱屢疏言籌餉事，語多精覈。

translations.literal: War was then underway; Guozhu repeatedly memorialized on raising provisions, his language often precise and penetrating.
translations.idiomatic: War was then underway; Guozhu repeatedly memorialized on raising provisions, his language often precise and penetrating.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief of the left.

sentences.zh: 旋授江寧巡撫，請設機制寬大緞疋。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed Governor of Jiangning and requested the establishment of looms to weave broad satin bolts.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed governor of Jiangning and requested the establishment of looms to weave broad satin bolts.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「非常用之物，何為勞費？

translations.literal: He received the rescript: 'These are not items in regular use—why labor and spend on them?
translations.idiomatic: He received the rescript, "These are not items in regular use—why labor and spend on them?

sentences.zh: 」當明珠用事，國柱務罔利以迎合之，及內轉左都御史，遷戶部尚書，湯斌繼國柱撫江蘇；

translations.literal: ' While Mingzhu held power, Guozhu strove for illicit profit to please him; when he was transferred within the capital to Left Censor-in-Chief and promoted to Minister of Revenue, Tang Bin succeeded Guozhu as governor of Jiangsu;
translations.idiomatic: " While Mingzhu held power, Guozhu strove for illicit profit to please him; when he was transferred within the capital to left censor-in-chief and promoted to minister of revenue, Tang Bin succeeded Guozhu as governor of Jiangsu;

sentences.zh: 國柱索斌獻明珠金，斌不能應，由是傾之。

translations.literal: Guozhu demanded that Bin present gold to Mingzhu; Bin could not comply, and on this account Guozhu brought him down.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhu demanded that Bin present gold to Mingzhu; Bin could not comply, and on this account Guozhu brought him down.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，授武英殿大學士，益與明珠結，一時稱為「-{余}-秦檜」。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, bound himself still closer to Mingzhu, and for a time was called 'Yu Qin Hui.'
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-six he was appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, bound himself still closer to Mingzhu, and for a time was called "Yu Qin Hui."

sentences.zh: 會上謁陵，中途召-{于}-成龍入對，成龍盡發明珠、國柱等貪私。

translations.literal: When the emperor was visiting the imperial tombs, he summoned Yu Chenglong en route for audience; Chenglong fully exposed the greed and private conduct of Mingzhu, Guozhu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was visiting the imperial tombs, he summoned Yu Chenglong en route for audience; Chenglong fully exposed the greed and private conduct of Mingzhu, Guozhu, and others.

sentences.zh: 上歸詢高士奇，士奇亦以狀聞。

translations.literal: On his return the emperor questioned Gao Shiqi, who also reported the facts.
translations.idiomatic: On his return the emperor questioned Gao Shiqi, who also reported the facts.

sentences.zh: 及郭琇疏論劾，言者蜂起，國柱門人陳世安亦具疏糾之，頗中要害，國柱遂奪官。

translations.literal: When Guo Xiu's memorial impeaching them appeared, accusers swarmed forth; Guozhu's disciple Chen Shi'an also submitted a memorial accusing him, striking several vital points, and Guozhu was thereupon stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Xiu's memorial impeaching them appeared, accusers swarmed forth; Guozhu's disciple Chen Shi'an also submitted a memorial accusing him, striking several vital points, and Guozhu was thereupon stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 既出都，於江寧治第宅，營生計，復為給事中何金蘭所劾，命逐之回籍。

translations.literal: After leaving the capital he built a mansion at Jiangning and managed his livelihood; he was again impeached by Supervising Censor He Jinlan and ordered expelled to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving the capital he built a mansion at Jiangning and managed his livelihood; he was again impeached by Supervising Censor He Jinlan and ordered expelled to his native place.

sentences.zh: 卒於家。

translations.literal: He died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He died at home.

sentences.zh: 佛倫，舒穆祿氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Lun, of the Sumuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lun of the Sumuru clan was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自筆帖式累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: From clerk he was promoted in succession to Academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: From clerk he rose in succession to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂既死，其孫世璠猶據滇、黔，命佛倫總理糧餉，通鎮遠運道，旋兼理四川糧餉。

translations.literal: After Wu Sangui died, his grandson Shifan still held Yunnan and Guizhou; Fu Lun was ordered to oversee provisions, open the transport route through Zhenyuan, and soon also supervised Sichuan provisions.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Sangui died, his grandson Shifan still held Yunnan and Guizhou; Fu Lun was ordered to oversee provisions, open the transport route through Zhenyuan, and soon also supervised Sichuan provisions.

sentences.zh: 事平，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, he was transferred to Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, he was transferred to vice minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 尋遷左都御史，擢工部尚書，轉刑、戶兩部。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief, promoted to Minister of Works, and then transferred to the Ministries of Punishments and Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to left censor-in-chief, promoted to minister of works, and then transferred to the ministries of punishments and revenue.

sentences.zh: 先是下河工程，靳輔與按察使於成龍議不​​協，命佛倫偕侍郎熊一瀟等勘議。

translations.literal: Earlier, on the lower river works, Jin Fu and Surveillance Commissioner Yu Chenglong could not agree; Fu Lun was ordered, together with Vice Minister Xiong Yixiao and others, to inspect and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, on the lower river works, Jin Fu and Surveillance Commissioner Yu Chenglong could not agree; Fu Lun was ordered, together with Vice Minister Xiong Yixiao and others, to inspect and deliberate.

sentences.zh: 佛倫受明珠指，議如輔言，為總漕慕天顏所劾。

translations.literal: Fu Lun followed Mingzhu's direction and decided as Fu advocated; he was impeached by Director-General of Grain Transport Mu Tianyan.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lun followed Mingzhu's direction and decided as Fu advocated; he was impeached by Director-General of Grain Transport Mu Tianyan.

sentences.zh: 御史陸祖修亦劾佛倫袒輔，且言：「九卿會議時，尚書科爾坤等阿佛倫意，尚書張玉書、左都御史徐乾學言興屯所佔民田應還之民，科爾坤置不聞。

translations.literal: Censor Lu Zuxiu also impeached Fu Lun for favoring Fu, saying: 'At the conference of the Nine Ministers, Minister Ke'erkun and others flattered Fu Lun's intent; Ministers Zhang Yushu and Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue said the civilian fields seized for field colonies should be returned to the people, but Ke'erkun paid no heed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Lu Zuxiu also impeached Fu Lun for favoring Fu, saying, "At the conference of the Nine Ministers, Minister Ke'erkun and others flattered Fu Lun's intent; Ministers Zhang Yushu and Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Qianxue said the civilian fields seized for field colonies should be returned to the people, but Ke'erkun paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 他九卿或不得見隻字。

translations.literal: The other ministers sometimes did not even see a single character of the documents.
translations.idiomatic: The other ministers sometimes did not even see a single character of the documents.

sentences.zh: 」上怒，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: ' The emperor was angered and referred the matter to the ministries for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was angered and referred the matter to the ministries for strict deliberation.

sentences.zh: 及郭琇劾明珠，指佛倫為明珠黨，因解佛倫任。

translations.literal: When Guo Xiu impeached Mingzhu and named Fu Lun as a member of Mingzhu's faction, Fu Lun was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Xiu impeached Mingzhu and named Fu Lun as a member of Mingzhu's faction, Fu Lun was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 召輔等廷對，佛倫乃奏停屯田，並汰前所設官。

translations.literal: Fu and others were summoned for court audience; Fu Lun then memorialized to halt field colonies and abolish the officials previously established for them.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and others were summoned for court audience; Fu Lun then memorialized to halt field colonies and abolish the officials previously established for them.

sentences.zh: 部議奪佛倫官，上命留佐領。

translations.literal: The ministries deliberated stripping Fu Lun of office; the emperor ordered that he retain his company commandership.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries deliberated stripping Fu Lun of office; the emperor ordered that he retain his company commandership.

sentences.zh: 旋授內務府總管。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed Superintendent of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 出為山東巡撫，疏請均賦役，令紳民一體應役，詔嘉其實心任事。

translations.literal: He went out as Governor of Shandong and memorialized requesting equalization of tax and corvée levies, ordering gentry and commoners alike to perform corvée; an edict praised his earnest discharge of duty.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as governor of Shandong and memorialized requesting equalization of tax and corvée levies, ordering gentry and commoners alike to perform corvée; an edict praised his earnest discharge of duty.

sentences.zh: 初，濰縣知縣硃敦厚以贓私為巡撫錢鎯所發，乞徐乾學請於鎯，獲免，且內擢主事。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wei County magistrate Zhu Dunhou was exposed for corruption by Governor Qian E; he begged Xu Qianxue to intercede with Qian, was spared, and was even promoted within the capital to director.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wei County magistrate Zhu Dunhou was exposed for corruption by Governor Qian E; he begged Xu Qianxue to intercede with Qian, was spared, and was even promoted within the capital to director.

sentences.zh: 至是事發，下佛倫鞫實，乾學坐奪官。

translations.literal: When the affair came to light, Fu Lun was ordered to investigate the facts; Qianxue was stripped of office on the charge.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair came to light, Fu Lun was ordered to investigate the facts; Qianxue was stripped of office on the charge.

sentences.zh: 佛倫又劾琇知吳江縣時，嘗侵公帑，其父景昌故名爾標，乃明御史黃宗昌奴，坐賊黨誅，琇改父名冒封典，當追奪。

translations.literal: Fu Lun also impeached Xiu for, when he was magistrate of Wujiang, having embezzled public funds; his father Jingchang was formerly named Erbiao, a slave of the Ming censor Huang Zongchang, executed as a rebel partisan; Xiu changed his father's name to obtain enfeoffment honors by fraud, which should be revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lun also impeached Xiu for, when he was magistrate of Wujiang, having embezzled public funds; his father Jingchang was formerly named Erbiao, a slave of the Ming censor Huang Zongchang who was executed as a rebel partisan; Xiu changed his father's name to obtain enfeoffment honors by fraud, which should be revoked.

sentences.zh: 乾學故附明珠，後相失，或傳琇疏乾學實主之，故佛倫以是報。

translations.literal: Qianxue had formerly attached himself to Mingzhu but later fell out with him; some said Xiu's memorial was in truth Qianxue's work, and so Fu Lun repaid him in this way.
translations.idiomatic: Qianxue had formerly attached himself to Mingzhu but later fell out with him; some said Xiu's memorial was in truth Qianxue's work, and so Fu Lun repaid him in this way.

sentences.zh: 尋擢川陝總督，入為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon after he was promoted to Governor-General of Shaanxi and Sichuan, then entered the capital as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was promoted to governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan, then entered the capital as minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-eight he was appointed grand secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，琇入覲，訟父受誣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year Xiu came to audience and sued over his father's having been slandered.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-nine Xiu came to audience and sued over his father's having been slandered.

sentences.zh: 上詰佛倫，自承不實，當奪官，援赦得免。

translations.literal: The emperor questioned Fu Lun; he confessed that the charges were untrue and that he deserved to be stripped of office, but invoked an amnesty and was spared.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned Fu Lun; he confessed that the charges were untrue and that he deserved to be stripped of office, but invoked an amnesty and was spared.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以原品休致。

translations.literal: Before long he retired at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he retired at his original rank.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：康熙中，滿洲大臣以權位相尚者，惟索額圖、明珠，一時氣勢熏灼，然不能終保令名，卒以貪侈敗。

translations.literal: The commentator says: In the Kangxi reign, among Manchu ministers who vied in power and position, only Songgotu and Mingzhu—for a time their momentum scorched all around—yet they could not preserve a good name to the end and at last fell through greed and extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: In the Kangxi reign, among Manchu ministers who vied in power and position, only Songgotu and Mingzhu—for a time their momentum scorched all around—yet they could not preserve a good name to the end and at last fell through greed and extravagance.

sentences.zh: 索額圖以附皇太子得罪，禍延於後嗣。

translations.literal: Songgotu offended through attaching himself to the Crown Prince, and calamity extended to his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Songgotu offended through attaching himself to the crown prince, and calamity extended to his descendants.

sentences.zh: 明珠與索額圖競權，不附皇太子，雖被彈事罷相，聖祖猶念其贊撤籓，力全之，以視索額圖，豈不幸哉？

translations.literal: Mingzhu competed with Songgotu for power and did not attach himself to the Crown Prince; though impeached and dismissed from the chancellorship, the Sage Ancestor still remembered his support for withdrawing the princedoms and strove to preserve him—compared with Songgotu, was he not more fortunate?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu competed with Songgotu for power and did not attach himself to the crown prince; though impeached and dismissed from the chancellorship, the Kangxi Emperor still remembered his support for withdrawing the princedoms and strove to preserve him—compared with Songgotu, was he not more fortunate?

sentences.zh: 若國柱、佛倫，則權門之疏附矣。

translations.literal: As for Guozhu and Fu Lun, they were but distant adherents of the power clique.
translations.idiomatic: As for Guozhu and Fu Lun, they were but distant adherents of the power clique.
